why: Shell cycle 4 (docs/v3/cycles/shell-4.md) did not converge: 1 P1, no P2, 1 P3. This cycle rebuilds the same three-page app on master once both fix rows have shipped, to see whether the page kit now holds without the app reaching past it. docs/v3/CYCLES.md is the protocol.
what: Cycle 5 of the AppShell and page-kit area: build, measure, log, file. Protocol: docs/v3/CYCLES.md, which this brief only specialises. Start from the cycle 4 build in apps/playground/src/cycle/shell-4/: copy it to cycle/shell-5/ (routes under routes/cycle/shell-5/), delete every `cycle-shell-4:` workaround its fix row made removable, and log any that still cannot go.
owns: apps/playground/src/** (the cycle build only: new files plus nav registration)
change: Build a three-page app in the playground on the v3 shell with fixture data: (1) an overview with a PageBar (title, two actions, one filter), a stat row and a chart card; (2) a list page with a SplitPage master-detail and a PageAside inspector that opens from a row; (3) a settings page with InnerNav. Navigation comes from one nav definition: a phone tab bar with a More sheet, breadcrumbs, and a command palette entry per page. Exercise the phone (390x844), the docked aside (1800x1200), the collapsed rail, route errors, pending and missing states, a selection's crumb parent (a click keeps the document and the page's other params, closes a record open in the aside, and leaves focus in main), a switch of the selection with a record open, a palette jump to a page whose loader is pending, and a keyboard-only pass through every page that walks a record reached both by a click and by a deep link (Tab past the aside's close to the document end). Count: lines of layout glue the app wrote (wrappers, hand-built containers, calc() heights); escape hatches; places where the app had to know a shell internal (a CSS var, a data-slot, a z-index); keyboard traps, focus losses and misplaced focus. Compare every number with docs/v3/cycles/shell-4.md.
